bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 9 PM PDT THIS EVENING... Combined seas 7 to 9 ft tonight building to around 10 ft during the evening ebb. Seas subsiding Thursday, becoming 5 to 7 ft. Bar conditions rough to moderate this evening, becoming moderate Thursday. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 630 PM Wednesday, 715 AM Thursday, and 730 PM Thursday. The evening ebbs will be very strong.
